name: horror
title: Horror
description: Low, tense, intimate dread; slow pace, long silences, near-whisper intensity.
instruct: Speak in a low, tense, menacing near-whisper, slow and dreadful, as if telling a horror story in the dark.
sample: Don't turn around. [pause 500ms] Whatever you do, don't turn around. The thing behind you isn't breathing. [pause 300ms] It's counting. And it has almost reached one.
